title: Robert Pattinson is the new James Bond
summary: Amazon MGM Studios has confirmed the casting. Dune director Denis Villeneuve will direct the next 007 film.
body:
Robert Pattinson will play James Bond in the next 007 film, Amazon MGM Studios announced on Monday 16 November.

The studio said the casting would usher in a new era for the character. Pattinson called being entrusted with the role "the honour of a lifetime". He becomes only the seventh actor to play Bond in the official film series.

What we know

The film will be directed by Denis Villeneuve, whose credits include Dune and Blade Runner 2049. No title or release date has been announced.

Amazon MGM took creative control of the Bond films in 2025 under a deal with long-time producers Barbara Broccoli and Michael G. Wilson.

Sources: Amazon, ABC News, CBC News.
